notes: NOT RESOLVED UNILATERALLY. The instruction was to project onto an existing repository rather than create a rival, and that is what the `research-registry` target does today. Whether the two should MERGE is an operator decision with a migration behind it.
question: Do the repo-file resolution registry and the DB-backed research register (CFS-051) hold two overlapping ideas of "candidate principle", and should one absorb the other?
context: Found during the mandatory preflight. types/researchRegistry.ts defines CandidatePrinciple / CandidateInvariant / BacklogItem with their own status vocabularies (proposed|under-review|ratified|rejected and candidate|proposed-for-canonization|canonized|rejected), persisted to research_candidate_principles / _invariants / _backlog_items via services/research/registryStore.ts, surfaced by app/api/research/registry/route.ts and ExperimentRegistryTab. That is live, not dormant.
wouldRequire: An operator ruling on whether the two registers serve genuinely different domains — development resolutions versus the research programme — or whether one is a duplicate of the other.
If they are distinct: nothing more; the `research-registry` projection target is already the seam, and structural-track candidates project onto it rather than being copied.

If they are one: a migration, because the research register is DB-backed and the resolution registry is repo files, and a reconciliation of two status vocabularies neither of which may be silently rewritten.
